question: I'm a CS first-year student. I completed 15-122 this semester but earned only a D. Can I use this to satisfy the prerequisite for 15-213 next semester?
expected_answer: No — 15-213 requires 15-122 at least a C. A D does not meet this threshold. Additionally, the course description specifically notes that students must achieve a C or better in 15-122 to use it to satisfy the prerequisite for any subsequent Computer Science course.
common_mistake: Assuming any passing grade (D or better) satisfies CS prerequisites; not knowing the C-floor rule that applies broadly to CS prerequisite chains
needs_verification: Confirm P-001 actually earned a D in 15-122 (not a C or better)
Confirm the C-floor rule applies to 15-122 → 15-213 specifically
Confirm P-001 has not received a grade appeal that raised the D
